How work is assigned

Writers are matched to brands by specialism rather than availability. Payment and payout testing goes to the people who have run cashier operations; licensing and regulatory claims go to our analysts. Nobody reviews a brand they have a commercial relationship with, and nobody verifies their own work.

What "fact-checked by" means here

The second name on a review is not a proofreader. That person independently repeats the licence lookup against the regulator's register, re-does the bonus turnover arithmetic, and completes at least one deposit and withdrawal cycle of their own. Where the two disagree, the review does not publish until the discrepancy is resolved. The full standard is set out in our editorial guidelines.
